flags.sentence: Because treatment categories overlap (a patient can have several), Päijät-Häme's crude shares are above national levels for life-prolonging treatment at 44.5% (95% CI 40.7–48.3; n=293/659) versus 30.4% (4522/14873) and symptomatic treatment at 50.8% (95% CI 47.0–54.6; n=335/659) versus 39.5% (5871/14873), as the 95% confidence intervals exclude the national values.
flags.problem: Unsupported causal claim (overreach): the sentence states that Päijät-Häme's crude shares are above national levels 'Because treatment categories overlap', whereas the cited claims only note that categories overlap for both county and national figures and do not support overlapping categories as the cause of the county exceeding national shares.

flags.sentence: Since Health Care Act §52 sets no maximum time for a cancer suspicion and preliminary national figures show 58 days in specialist care, the team recommends reporting access times using THL guidance Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions (for 16 cancers) with handover alerts while the STM roadmap (measure 3.1.2) plans national pathway descriptions and access times by 2026–2028.
flags.problem: Overreach / missing scope qualifier: the cited STM roadmap claims (q:def306014c, q:b326e35410) state that measure 3.1.2 plans national pathway descriptions and cancer-specific access times for five (unnamed) cancers by 2026–2028 (and all significant cancers by 2029–2031), not for lung cancer or all cancers generally by 2026–2028.
